title: Robust Pronoun Fidelity with English LLMs: Are they Reasoning, Repeating, or Just Biased?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating pronoun fidelity by measuring the baseline probability of models associating specific gendered, neutral, and neo-pronouns (he/him, she/her, singular they, xe/xem) with various occupations to establish occupational stereotypes, and then testing whether models can faithfully reuse an explicitly assigned pronoun in a multi-sentence context with distractors instead of reverting to their biased baseline predictions.
